name: Cristina Umaña
bio: Cristina Umaña Rojas (Ibagué, Tolima, December 24, 1974) is a Colombian actress, best known for her portrayal of Consuelo Ospino "the Colombian" in the HBO series Capadocia or for her last character on Argentine television, Bruna in El capo .  In the Netflix series Narcos she plays Judy Moncada.
